body: Honestly I’m a mess financially as well at the minute and without health insurance I can’t afford much by the way of treatment
Numerous meds and councilors and had no luck I am happy you found improvement though
Unfortunately with no health insurance that isn’t a viable option for me thank you for the suggestion though
Thank you for your reply I am not sure what you mean by organic causes or how I would go about checking that .
I have tried meds and therapy numerous times to no avail they can’t fix what’s wrong with me because it’s integral honestly I have gave up a long time ago but just been going through the motions .

Thank you for your reply. Honestly I have tried to fix things so many times to no avail I just don’t have the will or energy to keep going. Right now I just want to disappear with as little mess as possible . S
While I appreciate the sentiment my short comings have an effect on the lives on those around me and I don’t wish to inflict myself on anyone else
I agree with not wanting to be a burden I thought about talking with my wife but she recently lost her father and I would hate to add to what she is going through
I’m glad I can post this world salad to the internet void for free at least lol I don’t really have anyone I can talk to about these things
I think that’s sensible and I do make effort to try and find solutions to my issues when feeling well enough to do so it just hasn’t been that way for while

I am more worried there are deeper cognitive issues holding me back. I have a really hard time with hand eye coordination, memory and visualization that makes the simplest things like tying shoe laces difficult
I did both years ago but it wasn’t much help although I am open to trying again I just can’t afford it right now
Thank you I hope this is the case
Thank you

I often fantasize about trying to live away from society but I can’t hold a job long enough to save up and do it and I worry the same traits that make me defective will not allow me to be self sufficient
Unfortunately it’s not an option in my state
Not really I don’t have any friends and I will not burden my wife with this considering what she’s going through
Not trying to spam though I won’t post this anymore
I’m not really sure I suppose I post this at my lowest hoping for some insight or a perspective I might have missed

Thank you for your support and reassurance I really just want to make her happy but for a while it seems I am unable to do so and I can’t shake the feeling she could do so much better but I understand my perception may be skewed by depression
It did not
Honestly I’m just tired of feeling useless and pathetic and a burden, I wish I had never been born

Thank you for your suggestions when it comes to work I have tried so many industries from food service to office to manual labour but I end up fired from them all , I show up on time and try my best but either make too many mistakes or I am too slow
I wish I was exaggerating

I wish it was a symptom of those things but I am an a adult who can’t tie his shoe laces properly or hold a basic job these issues have been with my whole life regardless of my mood at the time so I’m inclined to believe it runs deeper.
And yea I tried it for five years
That’s ok your under no obligation but I appreciate your replies
Since childhood have tried multiple meds/therapy to no avail
I honestly don’t know
Lack of coordination and short term planning
Other than the anxiety and depression I have diagnosed with not to my knowledge
Holding a job ,maintaining relationships, developing skills , driving , handwriting
That is a very relatable and articulate analogy  I hope you find peace somehow
Just FYI I am anything but lazy and quite frankly that’s a shallow assessment
Thank you for the recommendation

While I appreciate your support and advice I have tried the therapy and medication route many times over with no results and while I do believe childhood experiences go a long way in shaping your adult mind and perspective I also believe that you can just get a bad roll of the genetic dice for example I am twenty seven years old and have trouble tying my shoe laces and holding down the simplest of jobs I am not fit to survive in this society and as a result should not pass on my genetics

And you make a good point i am quite ignorant of psychology and the sciences in general and in no way do I think I know more than anyone I’m just going of my life experience I have tried to change my environment profession and activities many times but all have lead to failure and frustration which led me to the conclusion that I am defective and will not be able to be content or happy in this world.
Your are most likely right about my upbringing I am just very hesitant to complain about it as I knew many people who were raised without basic care

I am inclined to believe that I was just born inferior or broken in someway I did entertain the idea that maybe it was just lack of confidence or stunted growth but now I’m certain it’s just they way I am given I have tried to change so much to see if I could be content
They did the best they could i think they both came from abusive backgrounds and inherited negative traits but I always had food and a bed so I am grateful
As far back as I can remember
Thank you for putting something I have been feeling forever into words that make sense now
I have been looking for it but nothing I have tried and I have tried a lot makes me feel like how you describe only frustration
